aboutLead: Every scene has a heartbeat. Our job is to find it, protect it, and cut around it.
aboutText: Founded in Bangkok in 2021, LIMBIX CUT works across features, series, commercials and music videos for regional and international platforms. The name comes from the limbic system — the part of the brain that governs emotion — because we believe pacing and rhythm are emotional decisions before they're technical ones.
